title: Vehicle Towing, Indoor and Outdoor Storage, and Maintenance Services
detail_text: Combined Request for Information (RFI) and Sources Sought Notice (SSN) Vehicle Towing, Indoor and Outdoor Storage, and Maintenance Services The Drug Enforcement Administration (DEA) - Houston Field Division This combined RFI/SSN is issued for market research and planning purposes only (FAR Part 10; FAR 15.201). The Government seeks industry feedback to shape draft requirements and acquisition strategy and to assess the availability and capability of potential sources, including small businesses, to perform the requirement. Responses will inform decisions under FAR Part 19 regarding small business set-asides (e.g., the Rule of Two). The Government reserves the right to determine the method of acquisition and issuance of a possible solicitation based on the responses received for this notice. The Government's evaluation of the responses received will factor into the Government's determination whether any forthcoming solicitation will be conducted on an unrestricted or set-aside. Non-Solicitation/Non-Offer/Voluntary: This notice is not a solicitation and does not constitute a commitment by the Government. Responses are not offers and cannot be accepted to form a binding contract (FAR 15.201). Submission is strictly voluntary; the Government will not reimburse any costs associated with responding. Proprietary Information: No proprietary, classified, confidential or sensitive information should be included in your response to this RFI/SSN. Responses will not be returned. All documentation shall become the property of the Government. The Government reserves the right to use any information provided by respondents for any purpose deemed necessary and legally appropriate, including using technical information provided by respondents in any resultant solicitation. Posting and Follow-up: This notice is posted to SAM.gov Contract Opportunities as a Special Notice for RFI / Sources Sought Notice. Any future solicitation, if issued, will be posted to SAM.gov. Interested parties are responsible for monitoring SAM.gov for updates. Disclaimer and Required Provision: This notice is for information and planning purposes only. It does not constitute a solicitation, and the Government does not intend to award a contract on the basis of this notice. Responses are not offers and cannot be accepted by the Government to form a binding contract (FAR 15.201). Submission of a response is strictly voluntary; the Government will not reimburse any costs incurred in responding. The following Clauses are applicable to this notice: FAR 52.215‑3, Request for Information or Solicitation for Planning Purposes (as prescribed by FAR 15.209(c)). 1. Submission Instructions Response Due Date/Time : 16 March 2026 at 10PM EST. Submission Method: Subject line shall include: Notice Number and Company Name. RFI/SSN Responses/Capability Statements: Shall not exceed 10 Pages. PDF is preferred method. Interested parties must submit responses to the point(s) of contact identified below: Lead Contract Specialist, Kenny Douangmala at Kenny.J.Douangmala@dea.gov 2. Requirement Details: A. Description The Government in support of the Houston Field Division is seeking information on contractors interested in and capable of supporting its requirements. The DEA, Houston Field Division, requires Towing, Storage, and Maintenance Services. The DEA’s Houston Field Division seizes vehicles each year used for purposes of trafficking illicit controlled substances and has a requirement for contractor services to provide vehicle towing, indoor and outdoor storage, and maintenance services for seized vehicles and Official Government Vehicles (OGV). Reference: Statement of Work - Attachment "A3 - SOW - Towing,Storage, Maintenance Services" North American Classification Code (NAICS): 493110 - General Warehousing and Storage Small Business Size Standard: $30,000,000 Small Business Set-Aside: TBD Place of Performance: Texas - 77027, USA – See Statement of Work. 3. Responses At a minimum, responses shall include: Company Information: (name, phone number, UEI, CAGE Code, POC information, website, etc.) GSA contract(s): contract numbers and contractor’s socioeconomic status Description of your company’s capabilities as they relate to the services described in the Statement of Work – Attached to this notice. A description of your company’s previous experience providing the services described in this notice. A description of any teaming/subcontracting your company anticipates utilizing in support of this requirement. May include: Pricing models (not quotes or offers): This section will not count towards the 10page limit. Common pricing structures and units (e.g., per mile, per tow class, per day of storage by vehicle type, after-hours surcharges). Cost drivers the Government should consider in setting service tiers or performance levels. Any other relevant information that is not listed above which the Government should consider in finalizing its market research and acquisition strategy. 4. Point of Contact: Lead Contract Specialist, Kenny Douangmala at Kenny.J.Douangmala@dea.gov
